meaning/minute.why: Changed, severity 4 (X) or 3 (Y); both reasons fit.

meaning/whole.why: Both: changed, severity 3-4, tied to the modern-slavery point.

rule.why: Qwen3 and Parakeet both wrote 'slave'; the evidence holds.

rank.why: Identical: the two 'slave' engines tied first, Whisper last.

misses.why: Both find modern slavery->bothers me, slave->slick, stay su->stay sad, be like->were like and at work->it works. Only X also catches the invented 'I work with me', 'I be'->'I'd be' (an African American English edit) and gonna->can. X's extra trivia ('and', 'what', woah/oh, the way/why) costs little.
